Major AI Developments.title: A stroke can cut the line between intention and movement. This device tries to close the loop
Major AI Developments.summary: Nexactly AI Solutions has developed an EEG-based rehabilitation platform to help stroke patients regain movement. The platform aims to bridge the gap between intention and movement, and is being showcased on Shark Tank India. The innovation was created out of IIT Roorkee's innovation hub.

Major AI Developments.title: Kanwar Yatra: Delhi-Haridwar highway shuts from August 4, traffic curbs across western UP
Major AI Developments.summary: Western Uttar Pradesh will implement traffic restrictions from August 4 for the annual Kanwar Yatra, affecting the Delhi-Haridwar highway. Authorities have made arrangements for medical facilities, surveillance, and security, including AI-enabled cameras. Commuters can expect longer travel times and higher fares due to diversions and traffic curbs across the region.

Major AI Developments.title: IIITH’s TechForward roundtable defines Agentic AI as an ecosystem rather than just a chatbot or model
Major AI Developments.summary: IIITH's TechForward roundtable has defined Agentic AI as a comprehensive ecosystem, rather than just a chatbot or model. This definition emphasizes the broader scope and potential of Agentic AI, moving beyond traditional notions of AI as a single entity. The discussion is part of IIITH's efforts to shape AI governance and innovation in India.

Major AI Developments.title: IIIT Hyderabad Study Indicates How Public Procurement Is Shaping AI Governance In India
Major AI Developments.summary: A study by IIIT Hyderabad explores the impact of public procurement on AI governance in India. The research indicates that public procurement is playing a significant role in shaping AI governance in the country. IIIT Hyderabad is also involved in various other AI-related initiatives, including launching certificate courses and collaborating with other organizations to promote innovation and research.

Major AI Developments.title: Souvik Ghosh joins Forbes 30 under 30
Major AI Developments.summary: Souvik Ghosh has been named to the Forbes 30 under 30 list. IIIT Hyderabad is launching various initiatives, including a 3-month certificate course on Engineering Agentic AI Systems and an AI-powered cybersecurity initiative with Athenian Tech. The institution is also collaborating with ITDA Uttarakhand to promote innovation, research, and digital capacity.

Major AI Developments.title: IIIT-H launches 3-month certificate course on Engineering Agentic AI Systems
Major AI Developments.summary: IIIT-H has launched a 3-month certificate course on Engineering Agentic AI Systems. The course is part of the institution's efforts to advance innovation and research in AI. This initiative aims to equip students with the skills to design and develop intelligent systems.

Major AI Developments.title: How Tagbin turned an early bet on AR, VR, and AI into a Rs 250 Cr government-tech powerhouse
Major AI Developments.summary: Tagbin, founded in 2013 by three IIT Roorkee graduates, utilizes AI and immersive technologies like AR, VR, and holograms to aid governments in decision-making and create engaging public experiences. The company has grown into a significant government-tech entity, valued at Rs 250 Cr. Tagbin's innovative approach helps museums, exhibitions, and public spaces create interactive experiences.

AI Start-Up News.title: Bucketlistt raises pre-seed funding to scale experience tourism platform
AI Start-Up News.summary: Bucketlistt, a curated experiences marketplace, has raised Rs 1.07 crore in pre-seed funding at a valuation of Rs 10.07 crore from angel investors. The startup, founded in 2025, offers a platform for adventure, cultural, and spiritual experiences across India. Bucketlistt also operates OkGhumo, an ERP and CRM platform for experience operators to manage their businesses.
